name: qlrisk_price_private_equity_interest
title: Price a PrivateEquityInterest
description:
Price one Private Equity Interest (qlrisk PrivateEquityInterest): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): position_value (amount; default 1000000), ticker, quantity, currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: maturity, trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"position_value": 1000000, "ticker": "AAPL"} gives NPV 1,000,000.00 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
